name: Hong Kong International Airport

runway.v: three parallel runways (07L/25R, 07C/25C, 07R/25L), each 3,800 m long and 60 m wide

ppr.v: all non-commercial flights need prior approval from the Director-General of Civil Aviation, and final approval from the Aerodrome Control Supervisor on the day of flight
ppr.quote: All non-commercial fixed wing aircraft and helicopter flights at HKIA must have prior approval from the Director-General of Civil Aviation.

handling.v: flights for hire or reward are handled by the Hong Kong Business Aviation Centre, with parking on its own apron
handling.quote: Flights operated for Hire or Reward handled by Hong Kong Business Aviation Centre

noise.v: night noise-mitigation measures every day from 23:00 to 07:00 local time (preferred runway and approach use, not a ban)

missing: iata (AIP AD 2 page does not state it)
curfew (the AIP states no curfew, and does not state that there is none)
lead time for the CAD prior approval
notes: Noise window converted from UTC (1500-2300 UTC) to Hong Kong time (UTC+8); Hong Kong has no daylight saving time. The AIP page read is the 4 Sep 2025 amendment inside the eaip_20250710 package; newer packages (e.g. eaip_20260806) exist on ais.gov.hk but their AD 2 VHHH text page could not be opened from here, so re-check before publishing. The airport authority's 2021 press release confirms HKBAC operates the business aircraft facilities at HKIA (source hk-aahk-hkbac). AD 2.20 stand list for the HKBAC apron is printed with a typo in the AIP ("StandStands X1X2, X456 and Stand X458"), so stand numbers are not used. Re-researched 2026-10-29: Re-read of the 4 Sep 2025 AD 2 VHHH page: AD 2.20 gives no slot rules, no lead time for the Director-General's prior approval, and no size limits for the business-aviation apron; it states noise mitigation 1500-2300 UTC only. The eAIP history page (package eaip_20260514) lists AIRAC amendments 3/26 (19 Mar 2026) to 7/26 (9 Jul 2026), and a package eaip_20260806 exists, so the 4 Sep 2025 page used for the existing facts is superseded and must be re-checked against the current amendment before publishing. CAD's 'Schedule Coordination Guidelines for HKIA' could not be fetched (robots). AIC 29/19 (slots via the Hong Kong Schedule Coordination Office, 3 days ahead) covers helicopters only and was not used.
